Safari Flexagon Trolley Bag

MOQ 200 PCS

The Safari Flexagon Trolley Bag combines durability and ease of use, crafted from 100% polypropylene for long-lasting performance. It features four smooth-rolling wheels with 360º swivel capability, providing effortless maneuverability. A fixed combination lock enhances security, while the push-button trolley handle ensures quick adjustment and comfortable handling during travel. This bag is designed for professionals seeking reliable, efficient luggage for every journey.

Travel smarter, lighter, and in style with the Safari Flexagon Trolley Bag, a perfect blend of durability, functionality, and modern design. Engineered for today’s traveler, this premium hard luggage trolley offers the ideal balance between strength and flexibility, ensuring your journeys are smooth and stress-free.

Crafted from high-quality polypropylene material, the Safari Flexagon offers superior impact resistance while maintaining a lightweight structure — making it perfect for frequent flyers and vacationers alike. Its scratch-resistant texture keeps it looking sleek and new, even after long trips. The 360° multi-directional spinner wheels allow effortless mobility across airports, hotels, and busy streets, while the telescopic handle ensures easy maneuvering with a comfortable grip.

Inside, the spacious, well-organized compartments feature cross straps and zippered dividers that help keep your belongings neat and secure. Whether it’s clothes, gadgets, or travel essentials, there’s a place for everything. The combination lock adds an extra layer of security, making international travel worry-free.

Designed for performance and style, the Safari Flexagon Trolley Bag is available in multiple sizes to suit every traveler — from weekend getaways to long business trips.

Features:

  • Durable Polypropylene Shell: Lightweight yet strong exterior provides superior impact and scratch resistance.
  • 360° Spinner Wheels: Smooth and silent multi-directional wheels for easy movement on all surfaces.
  • Telescopic Handle: Ergonomically designed handle for comfortable and effortless handling.
  • Spacious Interiors: Dual compartments with cross straps and zippered dividers to keep belongings organized.
  • Stylish & Modern Design: Sleek, contemporary look that makes a statement wherever you go.
  • Lightweight Construction: Easy to carry without compromising on strength or capacity.
